title: Tiefling (Glasya)
contents: text | LanguagesCommon, InfernalASI2014: CHA +2, DEX +1 (or use origin ASI)
bullet | You can also cast these with spell slots you have.

title: Background — Sailor (Pirate)
contents: bullet | Ship’s Passage: Secure free passage for yourself and allies on a friendly ship (you help crew; timing at captain’s whim).
bullet | Variant — Bad Reputation: Folk fear you; you can often get away with minor crimes.
bullet | Belaying pin (club), 50 ft silk rope, lucky charm, set of common clothes, pouch with 10 gp.

title: Feat — Fey Touched (CHA)
contents: bullet | Increase CHA by 1 (to a max of 20).
bullet | Learn Misty Step and one 1st-level Enchantment/Divination spell.
bullet | You can cast both spells once without a slot per long rest; you can also cast them with your slots.
bullet | Your spellcasting ability for these is CHA.
bullet | Misty Step (always known via feat) — 1/day free.

title: Blue — Warlock L4 Snapshot
contents: bullet | Save DC: 8 + PROF + CHA mod • Attack: PROF + CHA mod.
bullet | Pact Boon: Pact of the Tome (L3) — Book of Shadows; 3 extra cantrips.
bullet | Invocations (2): Book of Ancient Secrets + (your choice).
bullet | Fey Touched: Misty Step (1/day) • Silvery Barbs (1/day).
bullet | Glasya: Minor Illusion (at will); Disguise Self 1/day; Invisibility (self) 1/day at L5.
bullet | Find Familiar, Detect Magic (ritual) — via Book of Ancient Secrets.

title: Navigator’s Tools — Quick Ref
contents: bullet | Set a course (WIS or INT + tool): plot safe route; avoid reefs, shoals, storms.
bullet | Dead reckoning (INT + tool): estimate position/time to destination.
bullet | Chart reading (INT + tool): decode currents, tides, landmarks.
bullet | Weather signs (WIS + tool): predict winds/storm shifts.
bullet | Combine with Vehicles (Water) for advantage when steering through hazards.

title: Vehicles (Water) — Quick Ref
contents: bullet | Helm a vessel (DEX + vehicles): tight turns, docking, evasive maneuvers.
bullet | Weather the storm (STR or WIS + vehicles): hold course in rough seas.
bullet | Trim sails / speed (DEX + vehicles): optimize speed vs wind.
bullet | Heave to: reduce speed; easier checks.
bullet | Full sail: gain speed; harder checks; risk damage in high winds.

title: Find Familiar — Quick Tactics
contents: bullet | Familiars can’t attack; they can Help to grant advantage, Scout, or Deliver touch spells you cast within 100 ft.
bullet | Use Dodge if exposed; keep to cover; communicate via telepathy (within 100 ft).
bullet | Spider/Lizard: climbing recon; vents and walls.
bullet | Octopus: aquatic ops; Ink Cloud getaway.

title: Blue — Roleplay & Quirks
contents: bullet | Charming but sly; enjoys harmless cons and dramatic disguises (thanks, Glasya).
bullet | Treats the Book of Shadows like a living pet; whispers to it before casting.
bullet | Superstitious sailor: never whistles on deck; pockets a lucky coin.
bullet | Protective of the crew; despises slavers and cruel captains.
bullet | Quirk: taps a three-beat rhythm before risky magic.

title: Combat Script — Boss (L4)
contents: bullet | If threatened: Misty Step (feat, 1/day) to high ground/cover.
bullet | Command familiar to Help vs the biggest threat (Owl Flyby).
bullet | Action: Target wounded with Toll the Dead; otherwise Chill Touch.
bullet | Bonus: Reposition; draw with Disguise Self shenanigans out of combat.
bullet | Movement: Keep 30–60 ft gap; break line of sight after casting.
bullet | Silvery Barbs (feat, 1/day) on enemy crits/clutch saves; grant ally advantage.
bullet | Maintain Concentration if any; take cover when hit.

title: Concentration — Quick Guide
contents: bullet | You can concentrate on one spell at a time; casting another concentration spell ends the first.
bullet | Concentration ends if you are incapacitated or if the spell says so.
bullet | When you take damage: CON save DC 10 or half the damage (whichever is higher).
bullet | One check per source of damage; multiple hits = multiple checks.
bullet | Take cover; use Dodge when focused; summon familiar to Help attackers away from you.
